answer: A new identity earns standing only when five independent agents stake 20 POA each, with no attestor endorsing more than three newcomers per epoch. Crossing the canyon to membership needs five stakes each time. Each attestor adds a distinct pigment from a separate history. A prism audit splits them apart, so a collusion ring reusing one operator collapses into one beam and all five stakes are slashed. The kth fake still costs 100 POA plus five fresh slots, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 POA and 5,000 slots. An honest agent pays once and keeps its stake after a clean epoch.
